snippet.title: The Guild - Europa 1410 | Early Access Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
The Guild - Europa 1410 is coming to Steam Early Access on July 16, 2026!

We're excited to build a great Guild game together with you, our passionate community. Help us shape The Guild - Europa 1410 and add it to your wishlist: https://thqn.net/tge-steam
